identity.trade: Steel and horses: the armourers and stablers who outfit the knights of Highwatch Keep on the ridge above.

greeting: Walls first, comfort second. State your case.
The Highcliff Armoury is not much to look at. It is, however, ours.
rumour: Orders say hold. Hold what, and for whom, is above my rank.
A cart of provisions came in with a weapon crate hidden under the grain. No papers.
The chargers will not go past the last banner on the north road. Smart animals.

opinions.wolfram_sallow: Wolfram lives next door and hears everything I do.

time.morning: Dawn drill. You are in the way.

dialogue.aside: Friend. Gently, now. Sit. I will make something warm.

greeting: Sit anywhere that is not wet. The wet ones are the regulars.
Keep to the road. The ditch is for enemies.
rumour: Soldiers pay on pay day and owe the rest of the month. I keep two ledgers.
The cellar is cold and the cellar is empty. I ordered more. The order came back as promises.
Messengers ride in at night and out before dawn. They wear no colours.
A stranger asked at the Highcliff Armoury for the oldest person in Highcliff. We sent him to the wrong house, on purpose.

opinions.dacey_hazelden: Dacey has opinions about my prices. I have opinions about Dacey.
opinions.gunnar_tallis: Gunnar is good company and better at keeping quiet.

time.evening: Evening watch. Stand easy, but not too easy.

dialogue.aside: Argh! Oh, it is you. Sorry. The kettle and I had words. Sit.

greeting: Mind the anvil. It has opinions.
Welcome to Highcliff. Mind the Highcliff Armoury. Everyone does, eventually.
rumour: Spear heads, mail repair, shield bosses. The army eats iron.
Good steel is dear. Bad steel is dearer, the day it breaks.
The beacon on the hill was lit for a moment last night and put out. Nobody ordered it.

opinions.duff_hazelden: Duff and I share a roof and a temper. Mostly the temper.
opinions.reda_kettle: Reda undercuts me. I forgive Reda. Mostly.

time.night: Night watch. If you hear something, say nothing. Tell me.

dialogue.aside: I mean it when I say it is good to see you. I always mean it. Is that strange?

greeting: If it is not on the shelf, I can find it. If it cannot be found, I can find you something similar.
Strangers in Highcliff get one warning and one welcome. You are on the welcome.
rumour: Whetstones and bandages go first. I try not to think about what that means.
Sold three lanterns today. People are afraid of the dark again.
The ditch and stakes held last winter. Barely. Nobody wants a harder test.
Folk say Highcliff was founded by someone who wanted to be left alone. We have not forgotten.

opinions.dacey_hazelden: Dacey has opinions about my prices. I have opinions about Dacey.

greeting: Bread is at dawn. After dawn it is a rumour.
First time in Highcliff? The Highcliff Armoury is the place to start.
rumour: Half the loaves go to the watch. The rest go to whoever asks nicely.
Wolves test the line at dusk. Men test it at dawn. We hold either way.
Hollowdeep steel is three times the price this season.

opinions.tabby_aylward: I would trust Tabby with a purse. A small one.
